title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer Reportedly Not Using PS5's New QSSR Upscaler
description: Exploring Sony's new QSSR upscaler for base PS5 hardware, its current integration limits, and whether it has any immediate connection to GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Discussion Around QSSR and GTA 6 Integration

Sony's recent introduction of QSSR—bringing a version of the PS5 Pro’s acclaimed PSSR upscaler to base PS5 hardware—has sparked widespread discussion across the gaming community. With the tech rolling out, many industry watchers have speculated whether its introduction timing was specifically coordinated to coincide with the launch window of Rockstar Games' highly anticipated *GTA 6*.

However, industry analysis from media outlets like Push Square suggests that we are likely not seeing this new upscaler utilized in the existing *GTA 6* promotional material, prompting deeper conversations about how upcoming open-world blockbusters will leverage hardware-specific upscaling features.

## Current Adoption Status of QSSR

While Sony is making the technology available to third-party developers, its current integration is still in its infancy:

* **First-Party Integration**: The technology is currently incorporated strictly into first-party titles, specifically *Marvel’s Wolverine* and *Ghost of Yotei*.
* **Third-Party Availability**: Sony plans to open the tech to third-party devs, though widespread implementation will take time, with observers describing the technological leap for base hardware as "quite extravagant."

Given that QSSR is still making its way out of first-party studios, third-party adoption for massive open-world titles like *GTA 6* remains a subject of ongoing industry speculation.

## Looking Ahead at Next-Gen Optimization

As the industry looks toward the technical demands of *GTA 6*, advanced upscaling technologies will play a pivotal role in balancing performance and visual fidelity. Whether or not Rockstar chooses to incorporate tools like QSSR down the line, hardware-level enhancements will continue to shape the conversation around console gaming.

## Editor's Take
While Sony's new QSSR brings impressive upscaling potential to base PS5 consoles, it's hardly surprising that *GTA 6* isn't showcasing it just yet. As the technology transitions from first-party exclusives to broader third-party availability, we will have to wait and see how developers choose to optimize their massive projects for current-gen hardware.
